title: Approximate Factor Models for Functional Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2201.02532v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a novel approximate factor model tailored for analyzing time-dependent curve data. Our model decomposes such data into two distinct components: a low-dimensional predictable factor component and an unpredictable error term. These components are identified through the autocovariance structure of the underlying functional time series. The model parameters are consistently estimated using the eigencomponents of a cumulative autocovariance operator and an information criterion is proposed to determine the appropriate number of factors. Applications to mortality and yield curve modeling illustrate key advantages of our approach over the widely used functional principal component analysis, as it offers parsimonious structural representations of the underlying dynamics along with gains in out-of-sample forecast performance.

translated_title: 函数型时间序列的近似因子模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的近似因子模型，专门用于分析时间相关的曲线数据。我们的模型将这类数据分解为两个不同的组成部分：一个低维可预测的因子成分和一个不可预测的误差项。这些成分通过潜在函数型时间序列的自协方差结构来识别。模型参数通过累积自协方差算子的特征成分进行一致性估计，并提出了一种信息准则来确定合适的因子数量。在死亡率和收益率曲线建模中的应用表明，我们的方法相较于广泛使用的函数主成分分析具有关键优势，因为它提供了潜在动态的简约结构表示，同时在样本外预测性能方面也有所提升。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对函数型时间序列的近似因子模型，通过累积自协方差算子的特征成分一致性地估计模型参数，并利用信息准则确定因子数量，在死亡率和收益率曲线建模中展现出优于函数主成分分析的样本外预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel approximate factor model for functional time series that decomposes curve data into predictable factors and unpredictable errors via autocovariance structure, demonstrating superior out-of-sample forecasting performance over functional principal component analysis in mortality and yield curve applications.
